titles.title: Reliable Entry for Medicines at Everyday Discounts through Importation with Effective Safeguards Act of 2004
A bill to amend the Federal Food, Drug, and Cosmetic Act with respect to the importation of prescription drugs by importers, and by individuals for personal use, and for other purposes.
Reliable Entry for Medicines at Everyday Discounts through Importation with Effective Safeguards Act of 2004
